content.prompt: Precisely edit this original full-frame grain-free Dreamerie painting of a vintage diver exploring waves of unmade bedding. Preserve diver anatomy/pose, helmet/body, bunny identity, framing, fabric/lighting and all other props. Exactly FIVE separate localized single-object parts change: 1 diver helmet's small SIDE circular grille changes from horizontal/vertical bars to DIAGONAL crossed bars, ring unchanged. 2 stuffed bunny's far RIGHT horizontal ear bends downward into a curled folded loop near its tip, same ear base/head/other ear. 3 small toy ship's pale sail at bottom LEFT billows to the RIGHT in a curved fold rather than flat triangular sheet, mast/hull unchanged. 4 biggest floating wooden block at center-right has its printed BLUE leaping rabbit changed to a seated upright rabbit silhouette, same block geometry/redstar other face. 5 brown triangular sewn patch on upper-right duvet has its LOWER-edge stitches cross in an X zigzag pattern instead of single perpendicular stitch marks, top/left edge stitches and patch shape unchanged. Five independent one-object changes, no swaps or unrelated animal/anatomy drift, no noise or tiny random specks. One full-frame counterpart.
